title: A chat reveal's moment between its render and the drop effect sits outside My data's view union
evidence: Closed 2026-11-14, naming only: no caller sees the gap. In it the union says page but shown() already returns page null (widget-src/src/lib/value-view-machine.ts:42-45), so the screen shows rows. A hook probe acted inside the gap (a layout effect in the reveal's commit, before its passive effect, real jsdom history) with typed input: a row press, an erase event, a browser Back, and showTable. On main and on a prototype of the remedy (a reveal event moving page to rows in render, the effect keeping only history.back() and the not-saved line), all four ended the same: rows, the not-saved line said once, the entry gone, and the same history.back() count (press 1, erase 2, Back 1, table 1). The remedy changes nothing a person sees because what acts in the gap is passive-effect timing: the old page's popstate and erase listeners (useValuePage.ts:96-113) stay attached until the passive flush in both designs, and history.back() is async, so a press in the gap is closed by the popstate either way. The erase-in-gap double back is the same on both and is not from this gap's union state. No prod code changed.
